brief: 3 novembre2026 — personnages plus déjantés BL2/Tiny Tina, mêmes identités adultes ; Oxanium pour lecture longue.

assets.name: mary
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached original Mary bust, an adult fictional BMad analyst.
Primary request: redesign this same recognizable woman as a MUCH MORE wild, eccentric Borderlands 2 / Tiny Tina's Wonderlands inspired NPC. The current image is too polite and realistically attractive: push toward bold comic caricature and irreverent scrapyard invention. Preserve her adult age, medium-brown skin, dark curly asymmetrical hair, gold hoop earrings, facial beauty mark and teal/orange palette.
Art direction: hand-inked thick-to-thin black contour, angular exaggerated facial planes, distinct hard-edged 3-tone CEL SHADING, bold graphic shapes and selective comic hatching. Large expressive eyes, one eyebrow arched extremely high, crooked knowing toothy grin, mischievous brilliant detective energy. Exaggerate the curly hair into an asymmetric unruly silhouette. Give her oversized brass-and-teal multiple-lens detective goggles perched above her forehead, red pencil stuck in curls, mismatched orange/teal scavenged shoulder plates, little folded map scraps and red-string investigation pins on the lapel, an oversized absurd magnifying lens hanging at chest. Intentionally theatrical asymmetric costume; still an original identifiable Mary, not an existing game character.
Composition: a SINGLE centered bust from head to mid chest, frontal three-quarter pose, entire hair/goggles/shoulders visible, square image. Face centered around 42% of image height and about 35% image width; leave generous 6% transparent padding all sides for the existing 40px dialogue thumbnail and full bust panel. Crisp readable silhouette at small size.
Transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no circle, no frame, no text or logo. Avoid photoreal skin rendering, soft airbrush, glossy 3D, generic heroic realism, delicate fashion portrait, smooth gradients. Flat saturated rust orange, petrol teal, ochre, cream and dark ink. Keep the original alpha transparency.

Redesign image 1 as an original MUCH more wild and theatrical Borderlands 2 / Tiny Tina's Wonderlands inspired adult workshop NPC. Subject: adult pale freckled woman, vivid short copper-red hair and green eyes, UX designer. Exaggerate into a jubilant wild-eyed creative gremlin: enormous asymmetric spiky forelock, crooked toothy grin, raised brow, oversized round paint-splattered safety goggles perched on her hair with a tiny bent antenna, mismatched teal/rust shoulder plates, many fat colored paint markers and rulers strapped like bandoliers, a stitched whimsical rabbit-face patch and a brass color-wheel gadget at her collar. Playful explosive Tiny Tina energy while clearly adult; keep her red hair and freckles.
Art style: exaggerated comic facial proportions and distinctive angular planes; thick-to-thin black hand-inked contour, 3 hard flat cel-shading tones, selective scratchy comic hatching; large readable graphic shapes. Funny asymmetry, irreverent ingenious costumes, expression that reads at 40px. No photoreal skin shading, no fashion-portrait smooth beauty, no soft airbrush or glossy 3D. Strong face contrast and eyes readable.
Composition: SINGLE centered head-to-mid-chest bust, three-quarter frontal pose, square canvas, entire hair, goggles and shoulders contained, about 6% breathing room on sides/top. Face center near 42% image height. A genuine transparent alpha background, clean silhouette. No scenery, no backdrop, no circle, no border, no words, letters, logo or watermark. Original character, no reproduction of an existing game's named character. Keep a human-looking face rather than monster proportions.
